source: Shipped Flutter UI (package `rectify`) rendered from real widgets, routes, and state under the Spanish app bundle. No marketing mockups, no fabricated screens.
captureMethod: flutter test widget harness on the host VM: RepaintBoundary.toImage(pixelRatio: 3) -> ui.ImageByteFormat.png -> File. Demo mode (offline, no network) drives the canonical 6-event calculation through the real calculation_flow controller and go_router routes; the device locale is forced to es so MaterialApp resolves the Spanish ARB bundle exactly as a Spanish device would.
network: none (demo mode is fully offline; no network calls, no HTTP)
captionPlanSource: docs/store-listing-tier1-localized.md §3 (localized marketing captions are intended overlays to be composited by the owner after native review; they are NOT baked into these raw frames).

refresh.reason: Re-captured from the current simplified shipped Settings and in-app Privacy screens. Same throwaway /tmp widget-test harness, iPhone 6.7" geometry, offline Demo-mode method, and RepaintBoundary.toImage(pixelRatio: 3) as the original set; only frames 03 and 05 changed.

shareTextPayload.textPayloadNote: The in-app Share BUTTON label is localized (es: 'Compartir el resultado'), but the TEXT the share action emits is currently locale-invariant English: ShareCopyBuilder.build takes no AppLocalizations and hardcodes the English brand/affix strings. The dynamic values (time, ascendant, confidence) come from the result data and are not translated. This is the shipped behavior as of Run D.4; it is documented here, not changed.
shareTextPayload.privacySafe: Contains only estimated time + rising sign + confidence + brand. No birth date, no birthplace, no life events, no PII.
shareTextPayload.exactText:
My TrueRise rectification result:
7:14 AM · Gemini Rising · 78% confidence

Calculated with TrueRise — birth-time rectification

limitations: The native OS share sheet cannot be captured from the host `flutter test` harness (no platform share-sheet surface in the binding). Frame 04 therefore shows the shipped in-app 'Compartir el resultado' button; the exact text payload the share action emits is recorded verbatim in shareTextPayload.exactText.

The share text payload is locale-invariant English even under the Spanish bundle (see shareTextPayload.textPayloadNote). Localizing the shared text is a future product change outside this screenshot run.

These are raw device-resolution captures with NO marketing caption overlays or device bezels. The localized captions (captionPlanSource) are [PROPOSED] drafts pending native review and are owner-composited work.

Times/signs/percentages come from the canonical offline DEMO dataset, not a live calculation. The DEMO badge is visible in-frame on the result and evidence screens, matching the honest, probabilistic framing required for store review.
iPhone 6.7" portrait only, matching screenshots/store/en. The same harness can emit a Play / other-size variant by changing the view geometry if a second set is later required.
